en_us.title: Modpack Update Available
message: A new modpack version is available.
Current version: {current_version}
Latest version: {latest_version}
Update highlights:
[+] Expanded ways to obtain EP: food now brings both leisure and EP, with Kaleidoscope Cookery adding new related content.
[+] Thinking... has been improved to enhance the tutorial gameplay. Create is not included here!haha
[+] Added several unique undead creatures.
[+] Some quests have been made easier.
[+] Updated several mods for a better gameplay experience, such as increasing the spawn rate of Dwarven villages.
[+] Fixed several crash issues.
[+] Optimized the modpack.
This update is the second part of version 1.0.3!
Please download the modpack from CurseForge.

zh_cn.title: 发现整合包新版本
message: 检测到整合包有新版本。
当前版本：{current_version}
最新版本：{latest_version}
更新内容：
[+] 扩展了 EP 的获取方式：美食不仅带来了休闲体验，也带来了 EP，森罗物语为此加入了相关内容。
[+] 思索... 现在能够进一步完善游戏的教程玩法。注意：这里没有机械动力！哈哈
[+] 添加了一些与众不同的亡灵生物。
[+] 部分任务降低了难度。
[+] 更新了一些模组，以达到更好的游戏体验，例如提升矮人村庄的生成概率。
[+] 修复了一些崩溃问题。
[+] 优化了整合包。
这次更新是1.0.3的第二部分内容！
请到官网或者夸克网盘下载整合包。
